options.title: GTA V sold {fact1} in three days. It never stopped 🎮
options.first_line: Grand Theft Auto Five sold over {fact1} in its first three days.
options.first_frame: A midnight game-shop queue under a giant GTA V box; the shop's till display above the counter already reads the billion-dollar figure and is ticking.

options.title: Grand Theft Auto V has sold {fact2} copies since 2013 🎮
options.first_line: Grand Theft Auto Five has sold over {fact2} copies, and it came out in 2013.
options.first_frame: A towering stack of GTA V game boxes rising out of a bedroom floor past the ceiling, a counter on the top box reading the copies figure.

options.title: A 2013 game still sells like new: GTA V's {fact1} start
options.first_line: In 2013, Grand Theft Auto Five took {fact1} in three days, and thirteen years on it is still selling.
options.first_frame: A dusty 2013 calendar on a game-shop wall next to a fresh GTA V box on the shelf, a price-gun sticker with the figure stamped on the box.

why: A named game everyone knows plus a sales count still climbing 13 years after release makes a stranger ask how a 2013 game keeps selling, and the box stack bursting through the ceiling with its counter reads without sound.
